messages:
Ivy: Fog is winning this morning. Ferry from Sausalito is delayed and they just announced visibility holds at the dock. Anyone rerouting? :fog: 
Noah: On the 28 bus now. Driver said ferries are doing a headcount because a corgi tried to lead a small parade onto the lower deck. Ticketing drama + cuteness = 10 min delay. :dog: :heart_eyes:
Sana: LOL corgi named Pixel apparently escaped a stroller. Photo in #random-photos. Also, if anyone needs dry socks, I have an emergency pair in my tote. Learned the commute lesson the hard way.
Devon: I might take you up on those socks. My shoes are now part-waterfeature. Also offering a ride from Mission to the office for one — small trunk only (no corgis). :car: 
TransitBot: Ferry status: https://sf-ferry.example/status/8742 
``n_service: Sausalito ferry | status: delayed (visibility) | est: 10-20 mins
``
Ivy: Thanks @TransitBot. @Noah, that corgi is trending in our channel. Pixel is now a morale booster. Could we start a "commute mascot" thread?
Noah: Vote: Pixel for official office mascot. React :dog: for yes, :thinking_face: for maybe.
Sana: :dog: and :socks: — donating the socks to whoever reaches the lobby first.
Devon: Heads up to folks walking across the ferry plaza  the boardwalk panels are slippery. Use the handrails.
Ivy: Also quick logistics: if you need a towel or change of shoes, there's a bin at concierge labeled "commute emergency". Big thanks to Facilities who restocked it overnight. :pray: 
Noah: Arrived at Embarcadero, Pixel safely reunited with owner. Mystery solved. Onward to coffee.
Sana: Update: left one pair of socks at concierge (size 9). If you claim them, please leave a thank you emoji.
Devon: Taking the single available spot in my trunk. Leaving now. If you see me honk once.
Ivy: Commuter status thread: Sausalito ferry delayed; N/S buses slow; one carpool heading to office. Pixel is hero. Stay safe and dry, everyone. :coffee:
